title: Modern cookery for private families

authorInfo.bio: Eliza Acton (1799–1859) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Modern Cookery for Private Families" by Eliza Acton is a cookery book first published in 1845. This groundbreaking work revolutionized recipe writing by introducing exact ingredients, quantities, and cooking times—a major departure from previous cookbooks.
